title: eval_ms_pipeline input
description: Input parameters for the MS acquisition parameter evaluation pipeline.

dataset.description: Dataset name (unique key in DATASETS configuration).

result_path.description: Path to search results: pFind result directory, msms.txt, results.sage.tsv, etc.

label.description: Group label shown in report title. Chinese characters produce Chinese reports.

enzyme_rule.description: Enzyme cleavage rule for FASTA-based QC. KR_C = Trypsin (after K/R). KR_N = LysargiNase (before K/R).

engine.description: Search engine. Omit or 'auto' for column-fingerprint auto-detection.

fasta.description: Path to protein database FASTA. Enables cleavage QC computation for non-pFind engines.

fraction_pattern.description: Regex to extract fraction number from raw filename stem. null for single-injection data.

id_pattern.description: Regex to extract (fraction, CV) from search result File_Name. null for single-CV data.

autolysis_pattern.description: Regex for enzyme protein IDs in Proteins column, e.g. 'CON_LysargiNase|CON_SL_LysN'.

autolysis_label.description: Label for autolysis peptides in report.

language.description: Report language. Auto-detected from label text if not specified.

has_ms1.description: True if .ms1 files exist (uses XIC streaming for FWHM). Default false (rawdump --xic).

faims_cv_colors.description: FAIMS CV to matplotlib color mapping, e.g. {"45V": "tab:red", "65V": "tab:orange"}.

output_dir.description: Output directory for reports and figures.
